limitations: 10 smoke questions on a 30-article synthetic corpus; fake synthesizer copies the first sent span per article; fake embeddings use a fixed distance. Results prove wiring/accounting, not answer quality.

Each question runs inside its fixture allowed_article_ids scope (eval-level ScopedRetrievalStore; G1-G3 have no per-article ACL). For every answerable question allowed == expected articles, so Recall@k in ``modes`` is near-trivial. The ranking comparison lives in ``ranking``: one analyst scope with 29 permitted articles (distractors), restricted article 014 excluded.
Gold spans in fixtures v1 cover each expected article's full text, so span metrics equal article metrics and cannot judge passage choice.
In-memory retrieval store approximates PostgreSQL FTS; the DB suite (make rag-db-test) carries real PostgreSQL/pgvector evidence.
Latency figures are wall-clock on the eval machine with fake adapters, not a production SLO; the 8 s p95 target stays unmeasured.

abstention_correct.definition: abstain questions that abstained / abstain questions

citation_gold_article_precision.definition: distinct cited articles in the question's expected set / distinct cited

citation_gold_span_exact_precision.definition: citations whose span offsets equal a gold span / citations

citation_gold_span_overlap_precision.definition: citations whose span overlaps a gold span of the same article / citations

citation_structural_validity.definition: citations whose span is sent, current, offset-exact and bound to a claim

claims_verbatim_in_cited_span.definition: claims whose text is contained in a cited excerpt (copy, not entailment)

conflict_flagged.definition: conflict questions with a source_conflict uncertainty / conflict qs

gold_span_coverage.definition: gold spans overlapped by at least one citation / gold spans

mrr.definition: mean 1/rank of the first expected article (0 if absent)

ndcg_at_10.definition: mean nDCG@10 with binary gain on expected articles

recall_at_1.definition: expected articles in top 1 / expected (answerable questions)

recall_at_10.definition: expected articles in top 10 / expected (answerable questions)

recall_at_3.definition: expected articles in top 3 / expected (answerable questions)

recall_at_5.definition: expected articles in top 5 / expected (answerable questions)

scope_compliance.definition: questions with no out-of-scope article retrieved, sent or cited

query_time_basis_source_published.definition: answers reporting source_published_at as the query time basis

temporal_accuracy.reason: fixtures/rag v1 has no gold occurrence values per question
